claim_ceiling: This candidate selects migration architecture and dependency rules only. It does not make imported material canonical, execute copies, delete sources, or activate runtimes.
dependency_rules: Authority may constrain other planes; imported authority may not constrain anything until admitted.
Product meaning may reference authority and contexts but cannot own implementation evidence by proximity.
Contexts reference Products and capabilities through explicit typed relations; directory nesting does not create context membership.
Implementation depends on Product and specification contracts; Product does not depend on a concrete implementation.
Evidence may support decisions but cannot redefine semantics or activate effects.
Platform declarations may be referenced by capability runtimes; capability runtimes do not duplicate platform definitions.
Generated human views depend on machine-canonical records and never reverse that direction.
observability_alignment: Dry-run reports counts, root digests, collisions, unmapped paths, and exclusions.
Effectful execution must append a per-file result journal and terminal receipt.
Partial execution stops at the first effectful failure and remains rollback-addressable by exact created paths.
No telemetry or receipt may imply semantic admission, registry activation, publication, or release.

observed_source.character: mixed authority, Product packages, context candidates, implementations, evidence, development history, installed dependencies, compiler outputs, and runtime state
observed_source.risk: A wholesale tree copy would collapse lifecycle and authority boundaries and transfer reproducible state as if it were authored source.

observed_target.character: clean-history successor with admitted identity/context foundations and candidate product/runtime construction
observed_target.constraint: Existing target bytes are preserved; imported source cannot override or become canonical by placement.

recommended_architecture.import_rule: An imports/cyberalchemy-v2 package is source evidence. Promotion into an active package requires an exact owner decision and does not mutate the imported bytes.

planes.owns: Lab definitions, Artifact Types, constitutions, decisions, schemas, and source admissions
Products, Product Capabilities, product ontologies, and product-construction candidates
Explicit Bounded Context identities, languages, maps, lineages, migrations, and capability instances
Projects, Goals, handoffs, owner coordination, and non-authoritative work ledgers
Research, inventory read models, validation, conformance, receipts, observations, and migration evidence
Languages, toolchains, runtimes, tools, profiles, locks, and environment declarations
Repository generators, validators, schemas, and migration tooling
Architecture, proposals, plans, and historical source documentation

recommended_architecture.principle: Separate active Lab packages from source-preserving imports at every plane.
recommended_architecture.projection_rule: Machine sources are canonical; human projections remain colocated and generated. No root generated directory is introduced.
recommended_architecture.recursive_context_form: A Bounded Context may contain its own language, maps, instances, specification/authored/generated, implementation/components/bindings, evidence, tests, construction, and handoff surfaces; those nested surfaces retain the same authority distinctions as root planes.
recommended_architecture.runtime_rule: Installed dependencies, compiler output, caches, activation state, and host bindings are reconstructed through platform profiles and locks, never migrated as canonical bytes.

testing_alignment: Every selected source byte is hash-bound to one target path.
Every excluded source entry is counted under one explicit exclusion class.
Target collisions fail closed; identical existing bytes are preserved rather than rewritten.
A rehearsal copies a deterministic sample into an isolated temporary root and verifies byte/mode parity.
Expected postimage is computed from the complete allowlist, not inferred from directory names.
Source and existing target bytes remain unchanged during build and validation.
